messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT P0 — routing fallback activated for account: Crescent Financial. Multiple 5xx spikes on dedicated-vpool-7 since 07:11 UTC. Auto-fallback to shared-hosted triggered. Paging on-call.

sasha (on-call): I'm on it. seeing elevated 5xx from ingress-gateway to model-service on 10.244.8.*/tcp. Reproducing now with curl — getting intermittent 502s.

alex w.: thanks. quick question — is this affecting only Crescent Financial traffic or broader egress? metrics show a spike in the dedicated pool's error rate tagged customer:crescent-fin.

maria p.: confirmed from logs: ~87% of failed requests in the last 3m are tagged crescent-fin. Other customers are within baseline. probably a degraded node group.

devops-jen: rolling a targeted drain for pod inference-7a2 on node gpu-12. command I ran: `kubectl cordon gpu-12 && kubectl drain gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — starting replacement.

sasha (on-call): good. please hold — we need to ensure we don't exceed concurrency quotas on shared-hosted for other customers. product-cx, heads up, Crescent might see reduced throughput while we stabilize.

product-cx: noted. drafting a short customer note now. will hold until we confirm mitigation plan.

incident-bot: Update: fallback routing currently serving ~40% of crescent-fin traffic via shared-hosted. Latency up ~60ms p50, errors down from 35% -> 12% but still above SLO.

alex w.: what caused fallback? I see an OOM spike and a GPU driver kernel restart on gpu-12 around 07:09. stack from node shows `nvidia/mig` alerts. Opening a ticket with infra.

maria p.: can we temporarily increase backup capacity for crescent-fin route? Suggest increasing concurrency cap from 50 -> 80 on shared-hosted for this customer until node pool is healthy.

devops-jen: I can bump the route policy. patch:
```
routeOverrides:
  crescent-fin:
    concurrency: 80
    fallbackPriority: shared-hosted
```
Applying now.

sasha (on-call): applied. watching metrics. also started a health-check loop on replaced pod. If errors drop below 5% for 5 minutes, we can start re-routing back to dedicated pool.

incident-bot: Monitoring rule `dedicated-vpool-7.errors>10%` still firing. Current alert: 12.3% (3m avg). Next alert threshold 5m.

alex w.: infra confirms node gpu-12 hardware fault. they are replacing the GPU and will rejoin the cluster after validation. ETA 22 minutes.

product-cx: draft customer-facing blurb (short):
"We detected elevated errors for Crescent Financial affecting inference throughput. Traffic was routed to our fallback service to maintain availability. Our engineers are replacing affected hardware and restoring dedicated capacity. You may see slightly higher latency; no data loss. We will update in ~30 minutes or sooner. — Redwood Inference Ops"

sasha (on-call): tidy. please send as a status page update with severity "partial-degradation" and targeted impact to Crescent Financial customers only. Use id `INC-5539991234`.

product-cx: posted to status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-5539991234: "Partial degradation — Crescent Financial experiencing increased errors; fallback routing active. Engineers working on hardware replacement. Updates every 30m."

maria p.: live mitigation checklist now: 1) increase fallback concurrency (done) 2) drain/replace bad node (in progress) 3) monitor error rate and latency 4) prepare customer targeted email if degraded > 60m

devops-jen: node replacement completed. pods rescheduled. running smoke tests: `python infra/tests/smoke_inference.py --target=crescent-fin --count=20` — 20/20 successful, p50 latency stable.

incident-bot: Alert cleared on `dedicated-vpool-7.errors>10%`. Current 3m avg 1.8%.

sasha (on-call): starting controlled re-route: decrease fallback weights to 10% over 2 minutes, then 0 if healthy.

alex w.: after 8 minutes of ramp we are at 0% fallback. Dedicated pool handling 100% of crescent-fin traffic. No elevated errors for 10m.

product-cx: sending customer follow-up email now. draft:
Subject: Update — Service restored for Crescent Financial
Body: "We completed a hardware replacement on a dedicated GPU node that caused intermittent errors earlier today. Traffic has been restored to your dedicated pool and normal performance has resumed. We apologize for the interruption and are performing a root cause analysis; we'll share findings in the next 48 hours. If you see continued issues, please reply or contact your account team."

sasha (on-call): nice. recommend adding a brief internal RCA placeholder: `RCA pending — GPU hardware failure (under investigation), driver restart observed`. Assign to infra for deeper analysis.

maria p.: assigning RCA to infra-ticket #INF-553999. will update when available.

incident-bot: Incident INC-5539991234 resolved. Duration: 00:41:56. Summary: hardware failure on gpu-12 caused increased 5xx for Crescent Financial; fallback routing preserved availability while replacement completed. Follow-ups: infra RCA, review fallback runbook timings, verify shared-hosted concurrency caps.

alex w.: thanks everyone. postmortem owner: maria p. I'll sync with infra for the hardware report.

sasha (on-call): handing off to morning oncall. leaving notes in #oncall-handoff. :white_check_mark:
